inventory.text: Career Seekers Your CNA Story Begins Here in the Central Valley Earn a salary as you train to become a Certified Nurse Assistant (CNA). Training includes hands-on practice and class instruction at a participating facility in your area. Start Your New Career Find a Training Provider Certified Nurse Assistant Certified Nurse Assistant (CNA): Your first step in a rewarding career in healthcare As a Certified Nurse Assistant (CNA), you provide compassionate care to seniors and people with disabilities in skilled nursing facilities across California. Today, more than ever, there is an incredible demand for CNAs to support America’s rapidly aging population. An estimated 1.3 million people resided in nursing home facilities as of 2020 Learn More Learn More About Long-Term Care Subscribe * indicates required First Name * Last Name * Zip Code * Email Address * SMS Phone Number Your CNA Story - By providing your phone number, you agree to receive promotional and marketing messages, notifications, and customer service communications from Your CNA Story. Message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Message frequency varies. Text HELP for help. Text STOP to cancel. See terms . Language Preference * English Español Tiếng Việt 简体中文 Select the language you prefer to be contacted in. Sign Up today Interested in learning more? Sign up here to receive information and guidance on how to create your own CNA story — via email and/or text message. CNAP EARN AND LEARN PROGRAM Train and get paid as you launch a rewarding career in healthcare as a CNA With the Certified Nurse Assistant Program (CNAP), candidates can Earn and Learn – meaning you can start working immediately while you obtain your certification. At qualifying facilities, you can get started through our Earn and Learn program. Here, you’re able to learn all the skills and receive hands-on training to become a CNA while still earning a salary. Get Informed Decide if a rewarding career in healthcare is right for you. Get Hired Find an Earn and Learn healthcare facility that is hiring. Complete in-person clinical training while you work and get paid. Get Certified Pass CNA competency exam and obtain State Approval Certified Nurse Assistant. Cost - $130 Find an Earn and Learn Training Facility Learn More About the CNAP Program Earn and Learn Advantages of Earn and Learn Launch a Career With no prior experience you can take control of your future and unlock endless opportunities for growth. Earn a Competitive Salary Unlike traditional educational paths, Earn and Learn programs offer the opportunity to earn a salary while you receive training. Smooth Transition into the Workforce Seamlessly transition from education to employment. Supportive Work Environment Employers who offer Earn and Learn programs prioritize the growth and development of their CNAs. Guidance and Mentorship Gain insights and support from experienced professionals who prioritize training and advancement. Career Seekers Quick Links What is Long-Term Care?
